thread.title: Wall Street Surges in Rally to Record Highs as Dow Jumps More Than 300 Points

title: Wall Street Surges in Rally to Record Highs as Dow Jumps More Than 300 Points
text:
Wall Street Surges in Rally to Record Highs as Dow Jumps More Than 300 Points January 17, 2018, 03:58:55 PM EDT By MT Newswires, MT Newswires Shutterstock photo 
Wall Street surged on Wednesday, with markets poised to hit new record highs as they shook off the weakness from a day earlier. Financials turned positive and tech stocks rallied as all the sectors on the S&P 500 advanced into the green. 
The Dow Jones Industrial Average crossed above 26,000 for a second time in a more than 300-point jump and the Nasdaq Composite jumped on gains in technology names including heavyweight Apple ( AAPL ), which announced it will pay $38 billion in U.S. taxes on foreign cash repatriation and invest $30 billion over five years in the country.
